Quality control of stations against the background

Source: R/qc.R
bruce_qc.Rd

Compares every station with the background product (the nearest background cell, same day) and flags stations that behave unlike the rest of their own network. A network's typical difference to the background is expected (that is its bias, which the model estimates); what is suspect is a station far from its own network, or one that swings much more than the others from day to day. A broken humidity sensor, a station with wrong coordinates or a sensor in direct sun show up this way.

Usage

bruce_qc(d, threshold = 3, min_days = 5, drop = FALSE)

Arguments

d

A bruce_data.

threshold

Flag a station whose mean difference is more than threshold (in the variable's units) away from its network's median difference, or whose day-to-day standard deviation of the difference is above threshold.

min_days

Flag stations with fewer days of data than this.

drop

FALSE (default) returns the report. TRUE returns d with the flagged stations of biased networks removed, and the report in d$qc.

Value

With drop = FALSE, a tibble (class bruce_qc) with one row per station: n_days, n_compared (days with a background value), mean_diff and sd_diff (station minus background), deviation (mean difference minus the network's median), flag (reason, empty if none) and drop. With drop = TRUE, the filtered bruce_data.

Details

Without a background, each station is compared with the daily mean of the reference stations instead.

Stations of reference networks (bias = FALSE) are reported but never dropped: a reference station far from the background is more likely real local climate (a valley, the waterfront) than a fault.

Examples

sim <- bruce_simulate(n_days = 5, seed = 1)
d <- bruce_data(sim$obs, sim$stations, sim$sources, crs = sim$crs, background = sim$background)
bruce_qc(d)
#> <bruce_qc> 52 stations compared with the background (threshold 3)
#> Station minus background, by network:
#>     source      role stations median_diff flagged dropped
#>    lowcost    biased       40        1.65       1       1
#>  reference reference       12       -0.10       0       0
#> 
#> Flagged stations:
#>  station_id  source n_days mean_diff sd_diff                  flag action
#>      IOT022 lowcost      5     -1.87    1.44 -3.5 from its network   drop
